records.description: Actual verbatim interaction records supplied by the runtime, not a model-reconstructed transcript.

buffer_key.description: Runtime extraction-buffer key. Ordinary agents must not construct buffer bookkeeping.

content.description: The text stored in this item. For ingestion it must be the actual verbatim interaction.

occurred_at.description: The actual source assertion time in Unix milliseconds.

project_id.description: Runtime project context within the authenticated scope, not authority to access another project.

response_id.description: A retrieval response identifier returned by Stowage; used for attribution or audit, not a query.

role.description: The actual origin of an interaction: user, assistant or tool. Never relabel generated text as user evidence.

session_id.description: An existing host session reference. Omit unless a session-specific operation requires it; verified host identity takes precedence.

tenant_id.description: Runtime identity context; authenticated scope remains authoritative.

user_id.description: Runtime user context; a verified user claim cannot be overridden.
